name: markdown-xml-outline
description: Shows Markdown headings and XML elements together in the VS Code document outline.

markdownXmlOutline.xmlTags.description: XML tags to include in the outline. Leave empty to include all XML tags.

markdownXmlOutline.excludeXmlTags.description: XML tags that should not appear in the outline.

markdownXmlOutline.labelAttributes.description: Attribute names used to provide labels for XML symbols.

markdownXmlOutline.includeSelfClosingTag.description: Include self-closing XML tags in the outline.

markdownXmlOutline.showXmlAttributes.description: Show the selected XML label attribute in the Outline detail column.
